name: Cannibalization of the Priestess
disable: DC 28 Athletics check to push past or run away, or DC 28 Occultism check or DC 28 Religion check (expert) to exorcise the haunt
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after there are no bleeding creatures left in M2. If disabled, it resets after 1 day. Destroying Illcayna is the only way to permanently destroy this haunt.
routine: (1 action) The haunt converges upon all creatures currently bleeding in area M2. The targeted creatures must attempt a DC 28 basic Fortitude save save against 3d6 spirit,3d6 void damage from the spirits pulling and gnawing on their souls. On a critical failure, the creature also suffers 2d6 persistent,bleed damage.

items.name: Swarm
items.text:
Trigger A living creature enters the square of the town center

---
Effect All creatures within area M2 take 3d10 slashing damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save save). The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: Spectral undead converge on any living creatures to rip into and devour them.
